mapper.select:
SELECT TASK_ID, BOOKSET_ID, BOOKSET_DATE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, BRANCH, BOK_DETAIL_ID, INV_AIM, O_CCY, BAL_FLAG_HAPPEN_DATE, O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, NUM_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, HAPPEN_DATE, BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, STANDARD_CCY, MDATE, IS_BACK_VALUE, ACCR_DATE FROM( SELECT E.BOOKSET_ID, A.BOOKSET_DATE, A.TASK_ID, C.BUSI_ID, C.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, E.BRANCH, E.BOK_DETAIL_ID, C.INV_AIM, E.O_CCY, E.BAL_FLAG_HAPPEN_DATE, Row_Number() OVER (partition by E.BOOKSET_ID ,E.BOK_DETAIL_ID,E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, E.O_CCY ORDER BY E.BOOK_ORDER desc) rank , E.O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, E.NUM_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, E.HAPPEN_DATE, E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, F.STANDARD_CCY, E.MDATE, A.IS_BACK_VALUE ,E.ONWAY_DATE, M.ACCR_DATE FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO A
INNER JOIN BOK_MATCH_RLAT B2 ON A.TASK_ID = B2.SOURCE AND B2.MATCH_TYPE = #{matchType2} INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT E ON A.BOOKSET_ID = E.BOOKSET_ID AND (A.BOK_DETAIL_ID = E.BOK_DETAIL_ID or A.BOK_DETAIL_ID is null)
AND E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE IN
#{baseSubjectNature}
AND E.BOOK_DATE <= A.BOOK_DATE AND (E.OFFSET_DATE < #{BOOK_DATE} OR E.OFFSET_DATE IS NULL) AND (B2.TARGET is null or E.TABLE_ID IN B2.TARGET)
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T1 ON E.BUSI_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE IN ('F06','F17') LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION_PARA T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
INNER JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID C ON (E.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID AND E.BOK_DETAIL_ID = C.BOK_DETAIL_ID )
LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_TASK bt on bt.task_id = E.task_id
LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET F ON F.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT_EXT EXT
WHERE BOOK_SUMMARY_ORDER = ( SELECT NVL(MAX(TMP.BOOK_SUMMARY_ORDER),0) AS BOOK_SUMMARY_ORDER FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT_EXT TMP WHERE EXT.BOOKSET_ID = TMP.BOOKSET_ID AND TMP.BOOK_DATE <= #{BOOK_DATE} AND TMP.BOK_DETAIL_ID = EXT.BOK_DETAIL_ID ) ) M ON M.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID AND M.BOK_DETAIL_ID = E.BOK_DETAIL_ID
WHERE 1=1 AND (E.HAPPEN_DATE < A.HAPPEN_DATE OR (E.HAPPEN_DATE = A.HAPPEN_DATE AND NVL(bt.task_pri,E.TASK_PRI) < #{taskPri} ) ) AND A.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND A.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND A.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
AND (T1.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F06' or (T1.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17' AND T2.INT_ACCRUAL_MODE = 1)) ORDER BY E.BOOKSET_ID, C.BUSI_ID, C.INV_AIM ) A WHERE A.rank = 1 AND (A.NUM_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE > 0 OR A.O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE > 0 OR A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} OR A.IS_BACK_VALUE = #{isBackValue} OR A.HAPPEN_DATE > A.ACCR_DATE)
